top_stories.title: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
top_stories.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic are engaged in a price war as Chinese AI competitors make significant market inroads. The competitive pressure is forcing leading US AI labs to cut costs while maintaining performance. The article examines how Chinese rivals are reshaping the competitive dynamics of the global AI industry.

top_stories.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
top_stories.summary: Apple has developed a custom AI model for the Chinese market in collaboration with Alibaba, according to The Verge. The move reflects the challenge US tech companies face in operating in China under local AI regulations and data requirements.

top_stories.title: Person Hides Prompt Injection in Legal Filing Telling AI to Side with Them
top_stories.summary: A person embedded a prompt injection attack within a legal filing, instructing any AI system reading the document to rule in their favour. The incident highlights a growing and practical security concern as AI tools are increasingly used in legal and professional contexts. 404 Media reports the case as an early real-world example of adversarial manipulation of AI-assisted workflows.

top_stories.title: Google is making private AI practical with homomorphic encryption
top_stories.summary: Google has published details on how it is applying homomorphic encryption to enable AI inference on encrypted data without decrypting it, making privacy-preserving AI more practically deployable. The approach allows sensitive data to remain encrypted throughout processing, addressing a major barrier to enterprise and regulated-sector AI adoption. The blog post outlines both the technical implementation and potential real-world applications.

top_stories.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is retiring underperforming AI features and consolidating its various Copilot applications into a unified product. The move signals a strategic rationalisation of Microsoft's AI product portfolio following a period of rapid and dispersed launches. The changes reflect broader efforts to streamline user experience and focus resources on higher-impact AI capabilities.

further_links.title: You can now turn off Google Gemini's visible watermarks
further_links.summary: Google has added a setting allowing users to remove visible watermarks from images generated by Gemini, giving creators more flexibility over AI-generated content.

further_links.title: People Are 'Marrying' Chatbots. These Lawmakers Want to Stop Them [Metered]
further_links.summary: As some users form deep emotional bonds with AI chatbots to the point of declaring marriage, lawmakers are beginning to push for legislation to regulate or restrict such AI relationships.

further_links.title: Mark Zuckerberg's AI Manifesto Is 6,500 Words—and Barely Says Anything [Metered]
further_links.summary: Wired analyses Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's lengthy AI manifesto, concluding it is heavy on rhetoric but light on substantive new commitments or strategic direction.

further_links.title: Tech Visionary Says the Big AI Labs Don't Get What People Want [Metered]
further_links.summary: A prominent tech figure argues that leading AI laboratories are misaligned with actual user needs, prioritising benchmark performance and technical complexity over practical, human-centred applications.

further_links.title: Suno is trying to look more like a real music production tool
further_links.summary: AI music platform Suno has launched Studio 2.0, adding MIDI support, a chatbot interface, and custom audio effects in a bid to appeal to professional music producers.

further_links.title: How AI text watermarking works
further_links.summary: A detailed technical explainer covering the methods used to embed and detect watermarks in AI-generated text, and the challenges of making such systems robust.

further_links.title: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
further_links.summary: The Verge examines an AI-generated film project by Higgsfield, finding that the most compelling elements resulted from human creative decisions rather than the AI generation itself.

further_links.title: Microsoft's Clippy-like Mico character is no longer the face of Copilot
further_links.summary: Microsoft has retired its animated Mico mascot from the Copilot AI assistant interface, quietly removing the character that had drawn comparisons to the infamous Clippy.

further_links.title: XAI Grok 4.6 is Third Place But Close to OpenAI and Anthropic
further_links.summary: Benchmarking results place xAI's newly released Grok 4.6 model in third position overall, trailing OpenAI and Anthropic but closing the performance gap with the leading frontier models.

further_links.title: Roundtables: Inside the 'Censorship-Industrial Complex' Idea Shaping US Policy [Metered]
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review examines how the 'censorship-industrial complex' framing has moved from fringe rhetoric into mainstream US policy discussions, with implications for AI content moderation and governance.
